ideas.title: Printed indoor routes keep museum visitors satisfied during weather closures
ideas.description: Show how a free sculpture route gives visitors a satisfying fallback when a flooded garden is closed. In the museum's two April openings, the front desk issued 38 printed routes.
ideas.audience: Museum visitors planning to see the sculpture garden
ideas.rationale: The handout count demonstrates that the substitute route protects the visitor experience. The museum can use the story to explain the indoor option during temporary closures.
ideas.evidence: The museum handed out 38 printed routes at two April Sunday openings. The route follows step-free public corridors from the desk to the café.

blockingIssues.constraint: The evidence supports availability of a visitor alternative during high water, without a demonstrated satisfaction outcome.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: The museum counted 38 copies at two wet Sunday openings, did not systematically count completed routes and did not track satisfaction. The route is offered for high-water garden closures.
blockingIssues.problem: Visitor satisfaction and broad weather-closure benefits are asserted without supporting measurements.
